content: वर्धन {%a.%} [वृध्-णिच् ल्यु ल्युट् वा] .²1 Increasing, growing. .²2 Causing to increase, enlarging, magnifying. .{@-नः@} A bestower of prosperity. .²2 A tooth growing over another tooth. .²3 <ab>N.</ab> of Śiva. .{@-नी@} .²1 A broom. .²2 A bier. .²3 A water-jar of a particular shape. .{@-नम्@} .²1 Growing, thriving. .²2 Growth, increase, prosperity, magnifying, enlargement. .²4 Elevation. .²5 Exhilaration (of spirits), animation. .²6 Educating, rearing. .²7 Cutting, dividing; as in नाभिवर्धनम्; प्राङ्नाभिवर्धनात् पुंसो जातकर्म विधीयते <ls>Mb. 3. 180. 34</ls>; annihilation; ततो राजन् महानासीत् संग्रामो भूरिवर्धनः <ls>Mb. 7. 153. 44</ls>. .²8 A means of strengthening, restorative. .²9 Filling.
